scope: 2026-10-17 unified restyle of care props: shared four-step palette, 1/16-grid low-poly meshes, no black outlines; shop goods are cream ceramic, mint plastic, strawberry fabric and kraft paper, wild items are leaves, twigs, straw, cardboard and soil. User-confirmed leaf bed, twig barrier and house eggs are untouched.

vanilla_texture_references.note: Parts of these meshes name vanilla textures instead of carrying pixels; they resolve to the player's Minecraft resources at runtime and are not stored in the repository.

forest_burrow/personal_leaf_nest/bedding: block/oak_leaves, birch_leaves, spruce_leaves (tinted), short_grass, moss_block, podzol_top, coarse_dirt, oak_log, spruce_log, hay_block_top, item/wheat
predator_nest: block/oak_log, spruce_log, hay_block_side, moss_block, podzol_top, oak_leaves (dry tint), birch_leaves, dead_bush, item/feather
predator_nest_frame: block/oak_log, spruce_log (native block models predator_nest_frame_1..7 from care-props/wild.py predator_nest_frames, exported by art/props/predators/build.py)

models.ceramic_tunnel/yukkuri_slide/yukkuri_tra: standards/yukkuri-library/drafts/playgrounds/build.py (faceted low-poly and box assemblies with 1-texel-per-unit pixel-art textures, collision from the same dimensions, slide chute sampled along its slope; trampoline bed is unit 2 with its pivot at y 8 over a static faceted well with 16 visible radial steel springs; yukkuri_pool is the faceted white-enamel orange-juice tub with fill mesh yukkuri_pool_juice units 1-4), in-use preview standards/yukkuri-library/drafts/playgrounds/preview.py

block_style.style: vanilla-like: axis-aligned voxel cuboids on the 1/16 grid at one texel per unit, icon ramps lit from the top left, any rounded part an explicit stepped-round recipe (octagon/inset vessels, stepped sphere) with painted detail; small bottles and sacks are their 16x16 icon extruded like item/generated with vanilla hand angles and a 30-degree fixed view

models.food_bowl: standards/yukkuri-library/drafts/care-props/bowl.py (six dye styles; fills food_bowl_regular/_wheat/_forage, one heap per portion, units 1-8)
models.waterer, waterer_water: standards/yukkuri-library/drafts/care-props/waterer.py (round saucer at the bowl's footprint and rim height, cork collar and round glass jar with a transparent pane; waterer_water is the saucer water dish_water and one jar cylinder per portion, tank_u1-u8)

round.style: things round by nature are modelled round: smooth revolved and ellipsoid solids with hand-painted regions, the toys at two to three texels per unit; the toys are the placed world models, and the yarn ball and glass marble roll by the ground distance they travel while the dolls stay upright

vanilla_items.style: medicine and small handheld tools have no world model: a vanilla item/generated model on textures/item/<id>.png

material_tiles: kit.py material tiles: palette colours drawn as 16x16 texel tiles with sparse one-step pixel noise, world-aligned at 1 texel per unit (vanilla density), for the low-poly care props; the placed bowls and the waterer are round, the toilets block_style, the placed beds are placed_goods; wild self-built nests are wild.py

placed_goods.author: standards/yukkuri-library/drafts/care-props/bowl.py (round: bowl, its styles and fills); standards/yukkuri-library/drafts/care-props/waterer.py (round: waterer and its water); standards/yukkuri-library/drafts/block-props/devices.py (block_style: toilet); standards/yukkuri-library/drafts/care-props/placed.py (the three pet bed grades, pet_nest_fit_1..15, the 2x2 woven nest); standards/yukkuri-library/drafts/care-props/wild.py (large_wild_nest)
placed_goods.style: the bowl, its fills and the waterer round (round.style), the toilet in block style (block_style.style); the pet beds and the 2x2 woven nest are rounded low-poly solids (revolved circles / rounded rectangles, no staircase cells) with hand-painted regions at about one texel per unit, the three bed grades one geometry and one texture layout; several dye-selected styles per item on the same geometry; fills are heap-only meshes drawn inside any bowl style; the pet beds and the 2x2 woven nest collide along their visible top surface
placed_goods.styles_table: life/CareStyles.java (dye -> style) mirrors vanilla_props.STYLES; non-default styles ship as runtime-peripheral attachments named <block id>_<style>
placed_goods.runtime_hook: client/CareRenderer draws <model>[_<style>] from CareBlockEntity Pattern, then the fill mesh for bowls, and the stored droppings on the sand toilet floor
placed_goods.collision: src/main/resources/assets/mcyukkuri/yukkuri_presentation/care_collision.json (placed.collision(): the top surface of the pet bed per fitted mask and of the 2x2 woven nest, written by build.py; life/CareBlock builds the pet bed and large_yukkuri_nest collision and selection height from it)
